State Hall and Augustinian Reading Room

The Augustinian Reading Room will be closed from 4 p.m.

Legal notice

Information pursuant to Sec. 5 of the E-Commerce Act (ECG), Sec. 25 of the Media Act and Sec. 14 of the Austrian Commercial Code (UGB):

Provider of this website and content/editorial responsibility:

Austrian National Library
Address: Josefsplatz 1, P.O. Box 25, 1015 Vienna, Austria
Web: www.onb.ac.at
Tel.: +43 1 534 10
Fax: +43 1 534 10-280
Email: onb[at]onb.ac.at

Internet editorial staff: The content of the website is prepared and managed by the internet editorial staff at the Austrian National Library. In case of content-related enquiries, suggestions or complaints, please use the contact form.

Legal form: Federal scientific institution under public law
Company register number: FN 221029v
Companies’ register court: Vienna Commercial Court
VAT ID number: ATU54091307

Authorised representative:
Mag. Michaela Mayr, MSc, Director General
Mag. Richard Starkel (Commercial Director)
Authorised signatory Thomas Wollinger, MBA, Deputy Chief Financial Officer, represents the company together with a managing director

Rules of procedure for the management

Business purpose and principal direction:
The business purpose of the Austrian National Library is to collect, preserve, document and process the collections consigned to, or acquired by, the Austrian National Library on a permanent or temporary basis and make them available to the public, taking into account the principles of appropriateness, efficiency and economy. This website should facilitate public access to the information and holdings of the Austrian National Library.

Relevant supervisory authorities:
Federal Ministry for Housing, Arts, Culture, Media and Sport

Board of Trustees (economic supervisory body pursuant to Sec. 6 Austrian Federal Museums Act 2002):

GF Mag. Verena Brunner-Loss (chairwoman)
Mag. Werner Muhm (deputy of the chairwoman)
Dipl.-Ing. Roman Duskanich
Mag. Markus Feigl
Dr. Felix Hammerschmidt
Mag. Andreas Handler
Vorsitzender Mag. Dr. Eckehard Quin
Univ.-Prof. i.R. DDr. Oliver Rathkolb
Dr. Barbara Schaller
Univ.-Prof. Mag. Dr. Barbara Stelzl-Marx
Rules of procedure for the Board of Trustees

Legal foundations of the Austrian National Library are in particular the Austrian Federal Museums Act 2002 and the Library and Museum Regulation.

Guidelines on the legal collection assigment of the Austrian National Library can be found here.

Information about use and privacy can be found here.

Our internal reporting channel according to the Austrian Whistleblower Protection Act (HSchG) can be found here.

We use cookies

Our website uses cookies: in addition to those that are technically necessary for the functionality of our website and therefore cannot be rejected, we also use those whose purpose is to analyse website accesses, as well as those set by third-party providers such as Youtube and Google. With your consent to analysis and third-party cookies, data is processed both by us and by third-party providers, some of which are based in third countries (e.g. the USA). You can find more information about the tools and the partner:s in our data protection declaration. If you wish, you can adjust your cookie settings individually at any time via the link in the footer.

Data Protection

These cookies are necessary for the basic functions of the website. You can block or delete them in your browser settings, but then there is a risk that some parts of the website will not function properly.
  • PHPSESSID Technically necessary cookie from the web server. Storage duration: Session
  • fe_typo_user Used by TYPO3 as a user management function. Storage duration: Session
  • page-notice--hide Used to display the hint information function. Storage duration: Session

Required to obtain consent for certain cookies and thus for the use of certain tools.
  • cookieUser Used to recognise the browser and its cookie history (approval or rejection of certain cookies with date and time) using an anonymised identification number. Storage duration: 1 Year
  • fcc_cookie_consent Duration of storage of cookie consent. Storage duration: 1 Year
  • fcc_cookie_consent_minified Duration of storage of cookie consent. Storage duration: 1Year
  • cookie_matomo Duration of storage of cookie consent. Storage duration: 1 Year
  • cookie_ytvideo Duration of storage of cookie consent. Storage duration: 1 Jahr
  • cookie_gmaps Duration of storage of cookie consent. Storage duration: 1 Year

Required to maintain an active chat connection between you and the library and to save your session preferences (e.g., sound on/off).
  • libraryh3lp Links your browser to the active chat session to ensure messages are delivered correctly. Storage duration: Session
  • lh3_s_id Identifies the specific server instance for your chat (load balancing). Storage duration: Session
  • lh3_minimized Remembers whether you have collapsed or expanded the chat window. Storage duration: Session
  • lh3_sound Saves your setting (On/Off) for the notification sounds. Storage duration: Session

If you activate Matomo, we can analyse your use of our website in order to adapt and further improve our services. The following cookies may be set:
  • pk_ses Kurzlebige Cookies, die zur vorübergehenden Speicherung von Daten für den Besuch verwendet werden. Storage duration: 30 Minuten
  • pk_id Wird verwendet, um einige Details über den Benutzer zu speichern, wie die eindeutige Besucher-ID. Storage duration: 13 Monate

If you activate YouTube, videos from this provider will be displayed on our website. The following cookies may be set:
  • CONSENT Stores the consent status of Google services. Storage duration: 2 years
  • PREF Stores user preferences (e.g. language, video playback settings). Storage duration: 8 months
  • GPS Collects location data for mobile users in order to display geographically relevant advertising Storage duration: Session
  • APISID Creates a profile of the user’s interests and is used for personalized advertising. Storage duration: 2 years
  • SAPISID Also used by Google/YouTube for profiling and personalization. Retention period: 2 years HSID Security feature that prevents unauthorized access (e.g. session hijacking). Storage duration: 2 years
  • SID Contains an encrypted Google ID and the last login time, used for security and advertising purposes. Storage duration: 2 years
  • YSC Session cookie for the unique session/player ID (video statistics). Retention period: Session VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE Set by YouTube and used for various purposes, including analytics and advertising. Storage duration: 1 day
  • VISITOR_PRIVACY_METADATA Used to track and improve users’ privacy settings on the YouTube platform. Storage duration: 90 days
  • _Secure-3PAPISID Creates a profile of website visitors’ interests in order to display relevant and personalized advertising through retargeting. Storage duration: 2 years
  • _Secure-3PSID Creates a profile of website visitors’ interests in order to display relevant and personalized advertising through retargeting. Storage duration: 2 years
  • _Secure-3PSIDCC Security/advertising cookie within the Google/YouTube ecosystem. Storage duration: 1 year

If you activate Vimeo, videos from this provider will be displayed on our website. The following cookies may be set:
  • vuid Used to track the usage of embedded Vimeo videos. Storage duration: 2 years
  • __cf_bm Security cookie used to distinguish bots. Storage duration: 30 minutes
  • player Stores video player settings (e.g. volume, HD). Storage duration: 1 year
  • ab Used for A/B testing. Retention period Storage duration: Session
  • continuous_play_v3 Remembers whether the user prefers automatic playback. Storage duration: 1 year
  • optimizelyBuckets / optimizelyEndUserId / optimizelySegments Used for A/B testing and analysis of user interactions. Storage duration: variable (usually from session duration up to several months)
  • aka_debug Debugging cookie, sometimes set when there are issues with video playback. Storage duration: Session

If you activate Google Maps, maps from this provider will be displayed on our website. The following cookies may be set:
  • 1P_JAR Analyzes and tracks user interactions with Google services (statistics & advertising). Storage duration: 1 month
  • CONSENT Stores the user's consent status for Google services. Storage duration: 2 years
  • SID / HSID Security features, e.g., to protect against attacks (e.g., unauthorized login). Storage duration: 2 years
  • APISID / SAPISID Profiling based on user interests for personalized advertising. Storage duration: 2 years
  • SSID Authentication, as well as profile and usage data. Storage duration: 2 years
  • AEC Google security cookie, used to prevent spam, abuse and unauthorized access Storage duration: 6 months

If you activate Google Arts & Culture, maps from this provider will be displayed on our website. The following cookies may be set:
  • _ga tores a unique identifier to distinguish returning visitors and generate usage statistics through Google Analytics. Storage duration: 2 years
  • _ga_<id> Associates user interactions with a specific GA4 property to enable detailed analytics for a website or embedded service. Storage duration: 2 years
  • _gid Identifies users within a single day to collect short-term visit and interaction statistics. Storage duration: 24 hours
  • _gat Limits the rate of requests sent to Google Analytics in order to reduce server load. Storage duration: 1 minute
  • NID tores Google user preferences and may be used for personalized content or advertising across Google services. Storage duration: 6 months
  • VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE Used by embedded YouTube videos to estimate bandwidth and track usage behavior in order to optimize playback and recommendations. Storage duration: 6 months
  • YSC Assigns a unique session identifier to an embedded YouTube video view to track interactions during the current session. Storage duration: Session
  • VISITOR_PRIVACY_METADATA Stores privacy and consent-related information for YouTube and Google services. Storage duration: 6 months
  • TESTCOOKIESENABLED Technically verifies whether the browser accepts cookies so embedded functions can operate correctly. Storage duration: Session
  • __cf_bm Detects automated or suspicious traffic through Cloudflare to help prevent abuse and bot activity. Storage duration: 30 minutes
  • JSESSIONID Maintains a temporary server session so multiple requests from the same user can be linked together. Storage duration: Session
  • OptanonConsent Stores the user’s cookie consent choices and privacy preferences. Storage duration: 1 year
  • OptanonAlertBoxClosed Remembers that the cookie notice has already been dismissed so it is not shown again. Storage duration: 1 year

If you activate Beko Showcase, maps from this provider will be displayed on our website. The following cookies may be set:
  • __cf_bm Protects the platform against bots and abusive traffic. Storage duration: 30 minutes
  • _cfuvid Distinguishes users for traffic management and security analysis. Storage duration: Session
  • mp_* Enables viewer and account-related functionality within the Matterport system. Storage duration: Session
  • CookieConsent Stores the user’s cookie consent preferences. Storage duration: 6–12 months
  • _ga Identifies returning visitors for statistical analysis. Storage duration: 2 years
  • _gid Distinguishes visitors within a single day for analytics purposes. Storage duration: 24 hours
  • _gat Limits the rate of requests sent to Google Analytics. Storage duration: 1 minute
  • _ga_* Stores session-related information for Google Analytics 4. Storage duration: 2 years
  • _fbp Supports personalized advertising and marketing measurement via Meta/Facebook. Storage duration: 90 day
  • IDE Used to deliver and measure personalized Google advertising. Storage duration: 13 months
  • test_cookie Checks whether the browser supports cookies. Storage duration: 15 minutes
  • AWSALB / AWSALBCORS Distributes requests consistently across cloud servers. Storage duration: 7 days
  • sc_anonymous_id Recognizes anonymous users to improve the user experience. Storage duration: 2 years
